clauses.text:
Executive Order
California
Under authority contained in the act of June 25, 1910 (36 Stat .
, 847), as
amended by the act of August 24, 1912 (37 Stat .
, 497), and subject to the condi￾tions , provisions and limitations of said acts , it is hereby ordered that the public
lands in T. 11 N. , R. 5 W. , M. D. M. , California , be and the same are hereby with￾drawn from settlement , location, sale , entry and all forms of appropriation pending
a resurvey of said township under the act of March 3, 1909 ( 35 Stat .
, 845), as
amended by joint resolution of June 25, 1910 (36 Stat .
, 884 ) .
This order shall continue in full force and effect unless and until revoked by
the President or by an act of Congress .
THE WHITE HOUSE ,
June 6, 1927 .
[No. 4657]
C
